items.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I used to go to Minton’s, guys used to jam in there sometimes and play with Charlie Parker and Monk used to play there

ctx.x: The jam session was a big part of learning music.

Oh, yeah. I used to go to Minton’s, guys used to jam in there sometimes and play with Charlie Parker and Monk used to play there, and what’s her name, Carmen McRae, she used to sing there and she used to play piano sometimes. She played piano very well. And sometimes she would be there and I’d play behind here on something you know.
It seems like I read something about a fellow that you called “The Demon?” “The Demon?”
